messages:
sasha: Heads-up — noticed KV prefix cache hit-rate on prod dropped from ~92% to ~60% around 09:12 UTC. Any pointers on where the canonical dashboards/logs are? I can share a sample request id if helpful.

ben_hu: you'll want the kv-prefix-hitrate dashboard in Grafana — link: https://grafana.redwoodai.com/d/kvs/kv-prefix-hit-rate (panel: prefix_hit_rate_over_time). Also check metric `redwood.kv.cache.prefix_hit` in Datadog (rollup: avg by prefix).

maria_g: thanks. sasha can you paste one `request_id` so I can pull traces? I want to see if there are a bunch of prefix misses tied to a specific model version.

sasha: sure — req id `8f9b2c4a`. I saw this spike right after the 09:00 canary that bumped model variant alpha-3 -> alpha-4. Not sure if cache keys changed.

infra-bot: Alert triggered: `kv_prefix_cache_hitrate_low` (severity: warning) at 1796543380. Current value: 0.58 (threshold: 0.7). See runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-hitrate

ryan: quick note — the Grafana panel is computed as `sum(hit) / sum(hit + miss)` per prefix over 5m. If model variant changed key prefix (we recently added `model:v2:` prefix) it could split the warm set. Might need a backfill or multi-prefix lookup.

maria_g: pulling trace for `8f9b2c4a` now. If you want to query logs in Loki, use:
```
{job="kv-service"} |= "key=\"model:v2:...\"" | json | sort by @timestamp desc | limit 200
```
This will show prefix normalization steps.

oncall-liz: @sasha can you confirm whether the canary included cache-key changes in the PR? If yes, we should either: revert, add cache migration, or tune alert temporarily. I'm leaning toward adding a transient alert suppression for the canary window.

sasha: the PR had a minor normalization tweak: we started adding `model:v2:` prefix for embeddings. It's deliberate. I missed that it would affect hit-rate aggregate. My bad.

ryan: proposed alert tweak: change warning threshold from 0.7 to 0.55 for 30m after deploys tagged with `canary=true`, and add a datapoint check for sustained drop > 15% over 10m before firing. Example Datadog monitor query: `avg(last_5m):avg:redwood.kv.cache.prefix_hit{env:prod} by {prefix} < 0.55` with evaluation window 3/5 and notify: `@oncall`.

ben_hu: +1 to adding the evaluation window. Also opened a tiny dashboard PR to include `prefix` breakdown and `model_variant` label: https://github.com/redwood-inference/grafana-dashboards/pull/68 — @sasha pls review when possible :eyes:.

maria_g: trace shows ~30% of misses are from requests that now use `model:v2:` prefix while cache warmer is still populated for old keys. We can either do a background rewarm job or keep layered lookup for 1 hour. Rewarm probably better.

oncall-liz: I'll take this one — starting a rewarm job (dry-run) and will post progress. Also will temporarily mute `kv_prefix_cache_hitrate_low` for 45m to avoid noisy pager.

sasha: thanks all. I'll approve ben_hu's dashboard PR and open a tiny followup to add a note about canary key-prefix changes to the deploy checklist.

ben_hu: cool. marking this thread as FYI and leaving a :thumbsup:.

infra-bot: Incident note appended to ticket KVS-4432: "temporary hit-rate drop during model variant canary; mitigations: rewarm job and alert tuning".
